Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager
jobs.description_text: About ShyftLabs ShyftLabs is a data products and services company that partners with Fortune 500 organizations to solve complex business challenges through digital, data, and AI-driven solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a consulting mindset to build scalable, enterprise-grade platforms and products that drive measurable business impact. The Opportunity We are looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of complex, technically sophisticated products and platforms. This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role at the intersection of product, engineering, data, AI, and business strategy . You will translate ambiguous business and client needs into clear product direction while working closely with engineering and architecture teams to make informed technical and product trade-offs. You will partner directly with Fortune 500 clients and internal technical leaders across cloud, data, and AI initiatives. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at both the strategic and technical levels, able to define product vision and business outcomes while engaging deeply with engineers and architects on architecture, APIs, data, and delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description_text: Position Overview: We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support our Data team projects, with a primary focus on business intelligence development, analytical asset creation, and data-driven insights. The role will contribute directly to the delivery of the first phase of the project and will be responsible for developing scalable, high-quality analytical solutions. The ideal candidate is highly experienced with Power BI and Looker, has strong Python and SQL skills, and brings strong analytical thinking with exposure to machine learning. This role is expected to work closely with project stakeholders to translate business requirements into actionable dashboards, reports, and analytical assets. At ShyftLabs, we live and breathe data. Since 2020, we’ve been helping Fortune 500 companies unlock growth with cutting-edge digital solutions that transform industries and create measurable business impact. We’re growing fast and we’re looking for passionate problem-solvers who are ready to turn big ideas into real outcomes.

As a Software Developer on the Platform team, you will build and own features across the backend API, async worker infrastructure, and third-party integrations that keep the platform running for enterprise tenants. Four years of experience means you have shipped real features in production, you understand why tests matter, and you can design a data model before you open your code editor. You work independently on well-scoped problems, raise quality concerns early, and know when to ask for help before a decision becomes expensive to reverse. This is a backend-first role with a strong Python focus.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT SHYFTLABS ShyftLabs is a data and AI company. Since 2020 we've partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across retail, healthcare, finance, energy, and the public sector to turn messy enterprise data into systems that actually move the business. Our team of 200+ builds privacy-first AI, modern data infrastructure, and analytics products that have unlocked hundreds of millions in measurable value for our clients. We're scaling quickly, and we hire people who'd rather ship something real than write another deck about it. THE OPPORTUNITY We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own a portfolio of data and AI products and take Product from problem definition through launch and iteration. You'll sit between enterprise clients, engineering, and data science, translating ambiguous business problems into clear product bets, then driving them to delivery. This is a hands-on role at a company where the products are technical and the customers are demanding. You'll spend as much time in discovery conversations with client stakeholders as you do in backlog refinement with engineers. If you like owning outcomes rather than tickets, and you're comfortable being the person accountable when a launch either works or doesn't, this is a good fit. This role is based in Toronto and follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our downtown office.

You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. jobs.title: Integration Embedded Engineer
jobs.description_text: You'd join Embedded Platform, the team inside Samba's TV engineering org that turns Samba's ACR technology - audio, video, and TV signal capture - into something that actually runs on hardware. That means writing to spec, working directly with OEM and SOC engineering teams, and validating what partners ship back before Samba can use any of it. This is about as upstream as it gets: if the signal doesn't get captured off the device, there's no TV data downstream, and TV data is the base layer Samba's whole business is built on. Beyond the core ACR work, the team also powers mobile apps that use TV viewership data and an edge AI feature that recognizes video game titles and shoppable items showing up on screen. Q4 brings a new OEM project live - Sony's audio ACR work and the Titan OS integration are both active right now. Whether that runs in parallel with everything else already on the team's plate, or reshuffles who's working on what, depends on who's in this seat.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager

In this role, you will own our marketing technology stack, keep our data clean and trustworthy, and make sure every lead, campaign, and dollar can be traced from first touch to closed-won revenue. You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions. If you love building systems that scale, untangling messy data, and giving teams reports they can trust, this role is for you.

If you love digging into datasets, spotting patterns no one else has noticed, and turning numbers into stories that move audiences, this role is for you.

You will own the full partnership lifecycle with these platforms and, critically, connect their seller organizations to Samba's own brand and agency sellers so that demand moves through the channel rather than around it. Candidates must be highly motivated, possess outstanding communication skills, have demonstrated knowledge of the digital and TV advertising ecosystem, and be willing to work in a fast-paced, dynamic and growing environment. There will be opportunities to influence the direction of the product roadmap and the sales & marketing organization. Samba expects to offer a base salary between $110,000 - $120,000 per year for roles to be performed in New York or California; actual base salary offered will depend on various factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, and performance. Base salary is just one component of Samba’s total compensation package for employees. In addition, Samba provides health insurance, wellness offerings, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO), and other employee benefits.

jobs.title: Platforms Engineering Manager
jobs.description_text: Jaya, our CTO, has nine people reporting straight to her in Platforms and zero managers underneath. That's the gap. Nobody else owns this. Every product team builds on what Platforms ships. Sneak peek: in the next six months this splits further. You'd start as frontline manager for the Sama Data Platform and Cloud team. Once Platforms hires its VP, the org resettles around two managers and two architects reporting in above you, across what's becoming a 16-18 person department.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer, Learning & Inclusion
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work. You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Information Technology
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We are the team behind the technology that approximately 8,000 Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning endpoint and device management, identity and access, networking and connectivity, IT service management and support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity and collaboration platforms, work management tooling, and the AI tools changing how everyone at Spotify works. Across 9 teams, we touch almost every part of how Spotify functions as a company. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead a group of Engineering Managers and approximately 50 engineers and technicians across the studio. You’ll set engineering strategy, strengthen the technical practices that help our teams operate at their best, and partner closely with product and studio leadership to balance engineering investment with business priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Audiobooks Format Foundations
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks. This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Experience
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. Content Platform is responsible for the full content lifecycle at Spotify — from ingestion through to delivery — across music, podcasts, and audiobooks. We ensure content is structured, evaluated, and delivered reliably at global scale, powered by deep content understanding. We bring valuable content to users while ensuring it remains trusted and high-quality over time. The Product Insights team works across the full content lifecycle to improve decision-making, improve our catalog understanding and ensure one of the world’s largest content catalogs is safe and engaging. We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist to join the team and tackle complex, high-impact problems by combining strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

jobs.title: Tax Analyst
jobs.description_text: We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden. In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

jobs.title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
jobs.description_text: This role sits at the center of how Traackr customers get help and get their data. You will cover both L1 and L2 support for customers using the platform, and you will also help deliver the data integrations that push Traackr data into customers' own systems. You will work closely with Customer Success Managers, the operations team, and our data and product partners, learning the product deeply enough to answer hard questions and spot the patterns behind them. Success looks like customers who get fast, accurate answers, integrations that land on time, and support processes that get measurably easier to run.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Software Engineer you will work closely with our engineering, product, and design teams to implement the future of our product and build amazing experiences for our customers. To excel, you will need outstanding development and rapid prototyping skills and a keen eye for visual detail at the pixel level. You'll be involved in the entire product development lifecycle including the design, development, deployment and maintenance of new and existing features. You'll write clean and functional code on the front- and back-end for our world-class customers. You enjoy being challenged, love learning, be detail-oriented, appreciate working with people from diverse backgrounds, and be really passionate about what you do. This team owns the "micro loop" that brands, agencies, and influencer marketing managers rely on to find the right creators, launch campaigns quickly, and measure what's working, spanning discovery, campaign activation, and performance reporting. You'll build AI-powered features that sit at the center of that workflow: agents and MCP-based tooling, LLM-driven insights and recommendations, dynamic chat-based UI (using ag-ui), and the eval frameworks that keep those systems trustworthy, backed by Databricks pipelines and close collaboration with product and other engineering teams. The work is judged by real outcomes: how fast a marketer can build a shortlist they trust, launch a campaign with minimal manual effort, and see clear, actionable results.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Cloud, DevEx)
jobs.description_text: Traackr is a global SaaS technology company providing a data-driven influencer marketing platform that marketers use to optimize investments, streamline campaigns, and scale programs. Our customers range from some of the world’s largest companies in the beauty and personal care space to digitally native indie brands, which have all made influencer management and engagement a critical practice of their marketing and advertising programs. We are a remote-first company, and for the folks that like to meet in person, we have offices in San Francisco, New York, Boston, Paris, and London. We operate on a culture of mutual respect, with core value pillars including: Trust. We earn the trust of our team, customers, creators, and partners through transparency, predictability, and integrity. Diversity. Bringing diverse perspectives to the table results in stronger outcomes. All are welcome. Value. Through our words and actions, we strive to create tangible value for our customers and peers. We only succeed when our community succeeds. Ownership. We lead with action. We take pride in solving the hardest challenges and feel accountable for our commitments. Mutual success. We share goals with each other and with our clients. Alignment, collaboration, and empathy are the cornerstones of our success. This position is 100% remote, with the understanding that occasional in-person attendance may be required for trainings, meetings, and team gatherings, as determined by your manager.

jobs.title: Advanced Product and Solutions Lead
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Advanced Product and Solutions Lead will play a key role in technical customer engagements by managing product customization requests and elaborating detailed technical content, across both commercial and defense segments. The Lead will work with customer engagement teams, including Customer Solutions and Sales Engineering, to translate advanced customer needs into Lightspeed deliverables and provide advanced support to customers and partners (e.g. technical deep dives). The role sits within the Product Management organization for Telesat Lightspeed and works closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Customer Solutions, Operations and ecosystem partners. The role will work across the range of products and solutions offered by Lightspeed, including connectivity services, value-added services, security services, private infrastructure offerings, user terminals, and third-party integrations. This role requires strong technical depth, strong solutioning skills, a product mindset, and the ability to translate customer and market needs into scalable, commercially viable services. Resource is expected to be onsite at Telesat HQ, a minimum of 4 days per week.

jobs.title: Analyst, IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative professional to support the cybersecurity compliance activities of the Telesat Lightspeed program. The successful candidate will be responsible for assessing and monitoring the implementation of cybersecurity controls across Lightspeed systems and processes, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and certification requirements. This role will work closely with Engineering, Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to obtain evidence of control implementation, track remediation activities, identify compliance gaps, and provide ongoing assurance of cybersecurity readiness. The candidate will play a key role in coordinating compliance initiatives, maintaining program visibility, supporting assessments and audits, and helping ensure continued readiness for frameworks and certifications such as CMMC, IA-Pre, and other applicable industry standards.

jobs.title: Data Management Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Data Management Specialist will report to the Lightspeed Manager, Configuration Management & Change Control. The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Data Management Specialist will be responsible for the log, capture, processing and release of both internal and contractor delivered Telesat LEO Lightspeed documentation. The Data Management Specialist will support the Document & Data Management Specialist with the end-to-end processing of LEO Lightspeed Program data and documentation as well as other related activities required to support the Lightspeed work. The Document and Data Management Specialist will require a good working knowledge of document and data management processes and procedures with experience working with best practices standards such as CM2, ANSI-EIA 649, and/or ISO 10007 on medium sized systems integration Projects. The Document and Data Management Specialist will also require excellent organizational, language, writing and communication skills with intermediate to advanced proficiency using MS Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint). The role ensures that all data is accurate, traceable, audit-ready, and aligned with program baselines, supporting the successful delivery of high-reliability, mission-critical space systems.

jobs.title: Document Control Coordinator
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Document Control Coordinator will report to the Lightspeed Manager, Configuration Management & Change Control. The Document Control Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting mission assurance and program execution within Lightspeed Program. This position is responsible for the controlled management of technical and program documentation throughout its lifecycle, ensuring compliance with aerospace quality standards, configuration management principles, and customer/mission requirements. The Document Control Coordinator will require a good working knowledge of document and data management control processes and procedures with experience working with best practices standards such as CM2, ANSI-EIA 649, or ISO 10007 on complex, large to medium sized systems integration projects. The Document Control Coordinator will also require excellent organizational, language, writing and communication skills with intermediate to advanced proficiency using MS Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint). The role ensures that all documentation is accurate, traceable, audit-ready, and aligned with program baselines, supporting the successful delivery of high-reliability, mission-critical space systems.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Architect, User Terminals
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Software Architect - User Terminals will define and lead the software architecture for Telesat military and government satellite communication terminal solutions. The role provides technical leadership across programs, ensuring software designs meet system, security, operational, and long-term product requirements.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician / Technicien(ne) des installations
jobs.description_text: Télésat (Nasdaq et TSX : TSAT) est un opérateur mondial de satellites de premier plan qui fournit depuis plus de 50 ans des solutions de communication par satellite fiables et sécurisées à des clients du secteur de la radiodiffusion, des télécommunications, des entreprises et des gouvernements. Forte d'une tradition d'excellence en ingénierie, de fiabilité et de service à la clientèle de premier ordre dans le secteur, Télésat est devenue l'un des opérateurs mondiaux de satellites les plus importants et les plus prospères. Telesat Lightspeed, notre réseau révolutionnaire de satellites en orbite basse (LEO), dont la mise en service est prévue en 2027, redéfinira la connectivité mondiale à bande passante pour les utilisateurs professionnels en offrant une capacité, une sécurité et une résilience élevées, ainsi que des prix abordables, avec une latence ultra-faible et des vitesses comparables à celles de la fibre optique. Télésat a son siège social à Ottawa, au Canada, et possède des bureaux et des installations partout dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus, consultez le site www.telesat.com. English version to follow Aperçu du rôle Le ou la technicien(ne) des installations assure à ce que l’environnement du site demeure sécuritaire, fiable et pleinement opérationnel en tout temps. Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui s’épanouit dans un milieu technique, qui est fière de maintenir une infrastructure à haute disponibilité et qui apprécie la résolution pratique de problèm

jobs.title: Manager, Release Management and QA
jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Director, Service Management, the successful candidate will provide technical and team leadership for the testing, quality assurance, release management, and production operations of Lightspeed business and technical applications and platforms. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring high software quality standards throughout the systems development lifecycle and for supporting the operation of Telesat's Lightspeed production and test environments. Working closely with the Platform Engineering, Development, and IT PMO teams, the candidate will help plan, coordinate, and execute testing and production release activities while ensuring alignment with project schedules and operational requirements. The successful candidate will develop and maintain performance metrics, analyze results and trends, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Candidates must reside in the Ottawa area or be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided to qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - PLM Implementation
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to initially support the implementation of a new enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Reporting to the Program Management Office, the successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating project activities, maintaining governance processes, supporting stakeholder engagement, and ensuring project information is accurate, current, and accessible. This position is ideal for an individual with 3-6 years of project coordination or PMO support experience who thrives in cross-functional environments and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and accountability to complex business and technology initiatives.

jobs.title: Satellite Operations Engineer (GEO)
jobs.department: Space and Network Engineering - Satellite Operations
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Satellite Operations Engineer (GEO) will support all engineering aspects related to ensuring effective in-orbit operations of all on-board subsystems on the assigned GEO satellite bus type(s) in order to maximize health, performance and commercial availability. The incumbent will also 1) assist in maintaining the ground RF infrastructure utilized to support satellite T&C operations, and 2) support development of automated operations products to enhance efficiencies across all facets of in-orbit operations.

jobs.title: Security System Architect
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Security System Architect to secure next-generation satellite systems and support ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Senior Director, System Architecture and Release Train, you will lead the integration of cybersecurity across the product lifecycle, ensuring security is embedded from concept and design through deployment and operations. As a member of the System Architecture team, as the Security Champion you will work closely with Segment Domain Architects, engineering teams, and Product Cybersecurity stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity requirements are effectively incorporated into system architectures and product designs. Acting as the bridge between system architecture and cybersecurity, you will champion secure-by-design principles, assess cyber risks, and guide architectural decisions that enhance the resilience and security of space, ground, network, and cloud-based systems.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Canada Defence — Client & Program (ESCPP)
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for an exceptional Senior Director to be the single face of this program from Telesat to DND – owning the customer relationship and orchestrating delivery from build through to operational service. If you are energized by high-stakes defence programs, thrive at the intersection of customer, commercial and engineering, and want to help shape a nation’s strategic communications capability, this is a rare and career-defining role. This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Delivery Lead
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is responsible for driving integrated engineering execution across the Core User Terminal (Core UT) platform. This role serves as the central coordination point across multiple engineering disciplines, ensuring software, hardware, integration, test, and release activities are aligned to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes. Working within the User Terminal Engineering organization, the Senior Engineering Delivery Manager partners closely with Engineering Managers, Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Verification & Validation, Architecture teams, and the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to manage cross-functional dependencies, integration readiness, execution risks, and release delivery. As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Embedded Software
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible to build, lead, and manage a team of software professionals, including Principal Engineers, SW. Architects, Software Engineers, Associate Engineers, as well as Scrum Masters. The right candidate will develop strategies for the embedded SW development environment, including goals and plans in alignment with the group's development objectives. They will organize and lead scrum team events (with the help of the Scrum Master), foster a collaborative and motivated work environment, and enable and support data-driven decision-making. In addition, they will provide mentorship, guidance, and career development opportunities to team members. This is a highly technical role, focused on using embedded SW development experience to successfully manage this team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, GEO Spacecraft Operations Engineering
jobs.department: Space and Network Engineering - Satellite Operations
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Role Overview: The Senior Manager, GEO Satellite Operations Engineering will have overall responsibility for management oversight of technical personnel supporting the Satellite Engineering and Flight Dynamics operations activities of Telesat’s in-orbit fleet of geostationary satellites. As such this role is fully responsible for ensuring the health of all spacecraft subsystems, the effective maintenance of satellite orbits and assurance of fleet-wide space situational awareness in order to maximize transponder availability and customer business needs on a 24/7 basis. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a highly specialized technical team including assigning, scheduling and ensuring proper completion of duties. This oversight includes items such as; assigning spacecraft responsibility, maneuver planning or checking roles, seasonal spacecraft adjustments, on-call duty scheduling, timeliness of spacecraft activities, maneuvers or reports and any special projects deemed essential to ensuring business continuity. In addition to delegating assignments and managing the execution, the Senior Manager will serve as a technical liaison to guide implementation, ensuring compliance with Telesat’s operational standards. This includes, on an as required basis, engineering oversight of all resources assigned to each satellite bus type. For technical discussions, impacting fleet operations, the Sr Mana

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: Position Summary The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Network Management Software Developer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com As a Senior NMS Software Developer, you will lead the design, development, and evolution of Lightspeed's Network Management and OSS platforms, enabling service fulfillment, assurance, automation, and observability across a carrier-grade LEO satellite network. You will leverage modern software engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and AI-assisted development tools.

jobs.title: Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training to join our team, reporting directly to the GTM PMO & Business Operations Head. In this senior role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of high-quality training programs and enablement materials for Telesat’s Business Support System (BSS) and the Canadian Department of National Defence (DND) customer under the Enhanced Satellite Communication Project (ESCP) — a major contract award. You will be accountable for the full training deliverable set, spanning the BSS, LEO Mission and Network Operations training and User Terminal (UT) operations and field maintenance training, translating complex technical content into structured, self-paced, and instructor-led curricula that meet Canada’s accessibility, format, and Learning Management System requirements. If you are a proactive learning professional with a passion for building operational readiness and a proven track record delivering training in demanding, mission-critical defence environments, we encourage you to apply and help us achieve our strategic goals.

jobs.title: Senior User Terminal System Engineer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Telesat is seeking a motivated User Terminal System Engineer to support the development, integration, verification, and documentation of Lightspeed User Terminal solutions. This role provides exposure to advanced satellite communications, government and enterprise applications, mission-critical terminal use cases, and a range of suppliers. The successful candidate will work under the guidance of experienced systems engineers while taking increasing ownership of defined work packages.

jobs.title: TCC Technologist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Control Centre (TCC) Technologist works as part of a large team providing network surveillance, control, pro-active corrective and preventative maintenance support to Telesat's customers on a 24 hour, 7 day basis. The TCC technologist proactively monitors network services and fixed satellite service customers, and manages the troubleshooting and investigation of reported faults until services have been restored. They perform hands-on corrective and preventative measures to Allan Park earth station critical systems, TT&C ground communications equipment, and on-site customer services.

jobs.title: Technical Program Integration Lead
jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

jobs.title: Technical Writer, User Terminal (UT) Engineering
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Writer will support the User Terminal (UT) Engineering team by developing, maintaining, and improving technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle for Telesat Lightspeed User Terminals. The role will work closely with product managers, engineers, subject matter experts, and UT leadership to ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, traceable, and professionally presented. The successful candidate will be responsible for transforming complex technical information into clear, structured documentation suitable for engineering teams, suppliers, integrators, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will help refine documentation standards, improve document quality, manage document reviews, and ensure requirements traceability across the UT product portfolio.

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment.

jobs.title: User Terminal System Engineering Specialist
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Telesat is seeking an experienced User Terminal System Engineering Specialist to support systems engineering for Lightspeed User Terminal products and applications. This role will focus on requirements development and maintenance, Product Requirements Document support, architecture definition, requirements traceability, verification planning, and cross-functional coordination across engineering, supplier, and program teams. The successful candidate will work independently with internal teams, suppliers, and program stakeholders to ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, and aligned with customer and product objectives.

jobs.title: Counsel
jobs.description_text: Stand Together is seeking a passionate and innovative lawyer to join our high-performing in-house legal team. As Counsel, you will provide effective and efficient legal solutions related to lobbying, issue advocacy, and political activity to our non-profit clients and fuel their social impact. Our client organizations—including Americans for Prosperity (AFP), Americans for Prosperity Action (AFP Action), and yes. every kid., among others—are focused on multiple priority initiatives across government, education, the economy, health care, and foreign policy. Open to hiring as a Senior Counsel for a candidate bringing additional experience and leadership potential to the team. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $180,000–$225,000 per year.

jobs.title: Deputy State Director, Virginia - Richmond
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. As Deputy State Director for AFP-Virginia, you'll serve as a top strategic leader helping shape and execute the chapter's policy, political, and grassroots priorities across the Commonwealth. We're looking for an entrepreneurial, versatile leader who moves fluidly between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution, and who can travel regularly throughout Virginia. jobs.description_text: The Autonomous Pilot Integration team builds autonomy solutions for a wide range of CONOPs and mission sets. We combine capabilities from the Autonomy Capabilities team (motion planning, tactics), the Perception team (e.g., track fusion), and the HivemindSDK to develop the autonomy software that runs on an unmanned platform — air, maritime, space, or effects/expendables, depending on the program — then integrate, validate, and field it on the real hardware. In this role, you'll write new autonomy code — such as mission behaviors, platform-specific control, multi-agent coordination, contingencies, and executive autonomy — and own it end-to-end from software-in-the-loop, to hardware-in-the-loop, to vehicle-in-the-loop, to live test exercise. You'll partner closely with the Autonomy Capabilities and Perception teams, feature crews, and external platform integrators (vehicle/autopilot control vendors, C2 providers).
